title: Ye Janaza Hai Ali ka
body:
Haaye Ali moula
Haaye Ali moula
Ye janaza hai Ali ka shahe khaibargeer ka

Aaj baba mar gaya hai shabbar o shabbir ka

1. Fatema zehra ke marqad se sada aane lagi
Ye masayeb reh gaya tha kya meri taqdeer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ya rasool-Allah ye jibreel ne ro kar kaha
Ek halqa aur toota Noor ki zanjeer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kyun chalayi taygh hydar par bine muljim bata
Qatl quran kar diya kaata gala tafseer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Gham Ali ki betiyon ke phir se taaza ho gaye
Gham abhi bhooli kahan thi maadare dilgeer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Naz'a may jaane Ali ko kya khayaal aata raha
Moo kabhi Zainab ka dekha aur kabhi shabbir ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Betiyon ko dekhte hai aur rote hai Ali
Haaye wo zaalim tasavvur Shaam ki tash-heer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Chotay se Abbas bhi rotay hai sar ko peet kar
Bachpana Abbas ka aur zakhm dil par teer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Baap ki mayyat se Zainab ka lipatna baar baar
Dil hila deta tha rona shah ki hamsheer ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka....
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Shukr hai moula diya shabbir ne tumko kafan
Dhoop me lasha rahega bekafan shabbir ka
<<MINI>>
Ye janaza hai Ali ka...
